name: 🧼 Clean Your Keycaps [UPD]
desc:
These keycaps are DIRTY.🤢

How to play:
Scrub, rinse, and polish each one.
Place clean keycaps to earn money.
Upgrade your sponges and soap to clean faster!

Can you clean ALL the keycaps? 🧼
